release_notes: Integrated native ONNX Runtime inference layers for low-latency VAD and ASR.
Decoupled model weight checks to prevent disk bloat on 8GB RAM environments.
Integrated persistent Glassmorphism update notification pills and tooltips.
Integrated quantized Nemotron-3.5 STT model as the default voice recognition engine.

linux.update_command: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade vox
